questions.question_es: ¿Cuánto crecimiento turístico adicional cabe en Los Cabos si el agua desalada y el techo SIBCS no reescriben el crédito DMA?
questions.question_en: How much additional tourism growth fits in Los Cabos if desal water and the SIBCS ceiling do not rewrite DMA credit?
questions.planning_position_es: Tratar agua–energía como constricción vinculante del motor Cabos; no asumir que desalación equivale a margen ilimitado. Posición emergente alineada a scorecard constrained y señal de acoplamiento agua–energía.
questions.planning_position_en: Treat water–energy as binding constraint of the Cabos engine; do not assume desalination equals unlimited headroom. Emerging position aligned to constrained scorecard and water–energy coupling signal.
questions.demand_supply_notes_es: GDS Los Cabos = constrained: demanda aérea/turística vs. DMA 0317/0319 en déficit + techo SIBCS/transmisión. Celdas gap: settlement_coastal, land_pdu_status.
questions.demand_supply_notes_en: GDS Los Cabos = constrained: air/tourism demand vs. DMA 0317/0319 deficit + SIBCS/transmission ceiling. Gap cells: settlement_coastal, land_pdu_status.

questions.question_es: ¿Debe East Cape tratarse como edge de conservación (Cabo Pulmo / ANP) frente al desborde de Cabos, o como extensión turística residual?
questions.question_en: Should East Cape be treated as a conservation edge (Cabo Pulmo / ANP) against Cabos spillover, or as residual tourism extension?
questions.planning_position_es: Posición en disputa: techo de conservación vs. demanda de desborde. edge condition, no turismo residual.
questions.planning_position_en: Contested position: conservation ceiling vs. spillover demand. edge condition, not residual tourism.

questions.demand_supply_notes_en: GDS East Cape = contested; gaps in settlement_pressure, economic_jobs, land_instruments. DMA 0318 Pulmo on supply.

questions.next_evidence_en: Open East Cape scorecard and cross-check East Cape / San José del Este planning instruments and Barriles PSDU.

questions.question_es: ¿Cómo se asegura que La Paz permanezca como capital de servicios/gobernanza y no se convierta en un segundo Cabos?
questions.question_en: How do we ensure La Paz remains the services/governance capital and does not become a second Cabos?
questions.planning_position_es: Posición emergente: La Paz = coordinación estatal + acoplamiento agua–energía; no replicar el modelo resort.
questions.planning_position_en: Emerging position: La Paz = statewide coordination + water–energy coupling; do not replicate the resort model.
questions.demand_supply_notes_es: GDS La Paz = constrained; gap water_desal_lp. Roll-up estatal: La Paz carga coordinación.
questions.demand_supply_notes_en: GDS La Paz = constrained; gap water_desal_lp. State roll-up: La Paz carries coordination.

uncertainties.es: Hueco conocido: texto completo PMDU La Paz.
uncertainties.en: Known hole: full La Paz PMDU text.

questions.next_evidence_es: Priorizar cierre del hueco PMDU La Paz en catálogo y documentar rol de servicios en scorecard.
questions.next_evidence_en: Prioritize closing La Paz PMDU gap in catalog and document services role on scorecard.

questions.question_en: Should Loreto growth be subordinated to ANP/POEL ceilings, with WWTP/aqueduct as enabler or delay?
questions.planning_position_es: Posición contestada: nodo mid-península turismo+conservación; evidenciar techos antes de escalar oferta.
questions.planning_position_en: Contested position: mid-peninsula tourism+conservation node; evidence ceilings before scaling supply.

questions.demand_supply_notes_en: GDS Loreto = contested; gaps tourism_occupancy, water_dma_local, energy_local. LTO = 5 destinations.

questions.question_es: ¿Puede el headroom agro/producción de Comondú compensar el déficit sur (Cabos), o eso es una falacia de cancelación?
questions.question_en: Can Comondú agri/production headroom offset the southern (Cabos) deficit, or is that a cancellation fallacy?
questions.planning_position_es: Posición: los desequilibrios locales no se cancelan (NOM-011 por acuífero; SIBCS un techo). Comondú = segundo pilar productivo, no offset del sur.
questions.planning_position_en: Position: local imbalances do not cancel (NOM-011 per aquifer; SIBCS one ceiling). Comondú = second productive pillar, not southern offset.
questions.demand_supply_notes_es: GDS Comondú = headroom; state_rollup imbalances_es explícito. Gaps: air, tourism_demand, water_dma_irrigation.
questions.demand_supply_notes_en: GDS Comondú = headroom; state_rollup imbalances_en explicit. Gaps: air, tourism_demand, water_dma_irrigation.

questions.planning_position_en: Explicit gap (consensus status=gap): without comparable metrics, foresights and scorecards cannot close scenarios.
